reason: Honestly €29.99 for five pairs is a better deal than my Happy Socks, and a knitted duck is cute. But I've never heard of them, and paying €4.99 to wait for 100 strangers to reserve with no delivery date is too much of a gamble on my budget. I'd rather spend that on Zalando, where it shows up this week.
objection: Will this ever actually ship? There's no delivery date, no reviews, and I can't see the knit quality. 'Combed cotton' tells me nothing until I've held one.
would_change_my_mind: A real delivery date plus close-up photos or reviews from people who've actually got the socks. Or the deposit fully refunded if they never hit 100.
